parsed.name: Texas Instruments DLPC900 DMD 控制器
parsed.description: TI DLPC900 是用于 DLP6500 等 DMD 的可编程控制器，支持高速图案控制与高级光场控制。
parsed.description_en: TI DLPC900 is a programmable controller for DMDs such as DLP6500, supporting high-speed pattern control for advanced light control.
